decisions.reason: After the 2019 consolidation of similar tracking plugins and with no website visibility in 2020-2021, this product likely underperforms rising aspirations, so management would reallocate its resources to the stronger core and newer multichannel work.

Although close to the analytics core, two years without visible promotion suggest uncertain or weak standalone results, and a boundedly rational management in a growing firm would likely shift the capacity to established services and new development.
